title: Witch on Haunted Pier
description: A pink-haired witch in a black corset dress and tall hat stands on a wooden pier, holding a glowing jack-o'-lantern staff. Two translucent ghostly figures reach toward her from the water as she casts a swirling vortex of magic amid a stormy, ruined waterfront with a crumbling tower in the background.
prompt: A beautiful witch with long flowing pink hair wearing a black corset dress, thigh-high orange stockings, and a pointed witch hat stands on a wooden pier over dark water. She holds a tall staff topped with a glowing carved jack-o'-lantern. Two ethereal white and blue ghosts rise from the water reaching toward her. She is surrounded by swirling blue and white magical energy and sparks. In the background is a dark stormy sky with lightning, a crumbling ruined tower overgrown with green, and broken wooden structures. Halloween atmosphere, dramatic lighting, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
